snippet.title: Touhou Artificial Dream in Arcadia - Release Date Announcement Trailer (Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5)
snippet.description:
This fan-favorite Touhou DRPG fan game is making its debut on consoles!

Step into Gensokyo as Sumireko Usami, a high schooler with the power to visit this fantasy land in her sleep. Armed with her smartphone, she’s the only one who can stop a mysterious outbreak of doppelgängers—known as Sleepers.

Now available for wishlisting on the store page of the platform of your choice!

Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/touhou-artificial-dream-in-arcadia-switch/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013302
